comment: The Visual C++ runtime DLLs nanoserver-base copies into C:\Windows\System32 (issue 14). Each must pass the checks in Redistributable.psm1. To add one, follow .claude/skills/add-redistributable/SKILL.md.

redistributables.name: vcruntime140.dll
redistributables.neededBy: PHP (php.exe and every extension), MySQL (mysqld and the client tools), Helix

redistributables.name: vcruntime140_1.dll
redistributables.neededBy: PHP (the ICU DLLs used by intl), MySQL, Helix

redistributables.name: msvcp140.dll
redistributables.neededBy: PHP (the ICU DLLs used by intl), MySQL (mysqld)
